import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'])

# Create a new column for month-year
data['month_year'] = data['date'].dt.to_period('M')

# Group by month-year and product to calculate total sales
monthly_sales = data.groupby(['month_year', 'product'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a line plot
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))
sns.lineplot(data=monthly_sales, x='month_year', y='total', hue='product', marker='o')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Monthly Coffee Sales by Product')
plt.xlabel('Month-Year')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales (in $)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot

```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'])

# Create a new column for month-year
data['month_year'] = data['date'].dt.to_period('M')

# Group by month-year and product to calculate total sales
monthly_sales = data.groupby(['month_year', 'product'])['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a line plot
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))
sns.lineplot(data=monthly_sales, x='month_year', y='total', hue='product', marker='o')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Monthly Coffee Sales by Product')
plt.xlabel('Month-Year')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales (in $)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
